data.name: Stereo inspection microscope
data.function: Stereo zoom microscope (7–45×) on a boom stand over the assembly bench, used to inspect every wirebond, the junction-area wiring and the resonator surfaces before a package is sealed. A bond with a poor heel, a wire touching the ground plane, or a particle on the coplanar gap is visible here and invisible once the package is in the fridge; particles and resist residue on the metal edges are the two-level systems that set the internal quality factor and the qubit's T1 at millikelvin, so what this instrument finds is a coherence budget item rather than cosmetics.

physics.summary: Inspection of bonds and surfaces whose defects become TLS loss at millikelvin.

data.tooltip: Stereo microscope on the bench: inspecting bonds and chip surfaces.
